title: Grain Manifest v1
description: C2PA-COMPATIBLE manifest. Not full C2PA conformance - we implement the Soft Binding Resolution API shape and the soft binding assertion structure, but we do not run the c2pa-rs signing stack with X.509 certificates from the C2PA trust list. Say exactly this in the README; overclaiming in front of judges who know the spec is a bigger risk than the gap.

recordId.description: uint64 as decimal string. Sequential, assigned by GrainRegistry. Must fit the TrustMark payload - measure capacity in Milestone 0.

creator.description: Mera-derived signing address (HD index 0, namespace grain.identity.v1)

createdAt.description: Unix seconds, client-asserted. The chain timestamp is authoritative for ordering.

softBindings.description: ALWAYS contains the fingerprint, even when a watermark is present. That is what makes the anti-spoof cross-check possible (SPEC.md 2).

alg.description: com.adobe.trustmark.Q is C2PA soft binding algorithm list identifier 4. grain.phash.v1 is ours and is NOT on the approved list - algId 0 means unregistered. Do not imply otherwise.

generator.description: e.g. 'Grain Web 0.1.0', or an AI model name when registered by an agent

private.description: AES-256-GCM ciphertext of private fields (capture location, device, client name). Key derived via HKDF from the grain.vault.v1 PRF namespace. Only ciphertext ever leaves the browser. C2PA itself warns that identity assertions carry privacy implications - this is Grain's answer, and it is the novel part of the Mera integration. SPEC.md 9.3.

signature.description: EIP-191 personal_sign over keccak256(cbor(manifest without this field))
